en: The postcard shows a beautifully maintained, formal garden with geometrically trimmed hedges, vibrant flowerbeds, and a white bench set amongst greenery, with tall palm trees and other ornamental plants in the background. The caption at the bottom front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Partie aus dem Palmengarten,' suggesting a view from the Palm Garden in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in German, an 8-pfennig German stamp, postmarked 'Bad Pyrmont', and blue stamp of the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
